Contract Generator.contract:
Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		card: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		CardIDValidated.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		if card.oclIsUndefined() 
		then CardIDValidated = false 
		else CardIDValidated = true and
		InputCard = card 
		endif 
}
